name: content-strategy
description: Decide what your team should publish next: plan blog topics and content marketing priorities around your goals and company evidence, with a week-by-week content calendar that fits the hours your team actually has. From your existing article list, recommend which old articles to update, merge or retire; turn a chosen topic and research findings you provide into a writer's brief, and plan lead magnets for your topic clusters. It plans; it does not write the content or build campaigns.
